kind: Descriptive — what happened in a completed season, weighted by floor time (not a projection).

definition.rate_form: Per-game on-court impact, weighted by her share of team floor time.
definition.volume_form: That per-game rate accumulated across the games she played that season.
definition.impact_rating: Our on-court impact rating (how much better the team plays with her on).
definition.min_share: Her share of the game's floor time (minutes played out of the full game).
definition.context_earned_law: Floor-time share is exposure only — it never re-adjusts the rating.
definition.reading_a_completed_season: A finished season is read from our settled end-of-season impact estimate for that year. The current season is read from a live estimate that is still pulled toward the middle while its sample is young, so a current-season number is the more cautious of the two by design. Compare a finished year to another finished year first.
definition.thin: Flagged when that season's own sample is genuinely small — very few games, very little floor time, or a season where the model had no on-court read of her and fell back to what it expected. On a completed season this looks only at that year, so a veteran having a short year is flagged on the year, not judged on her career.
definition.prior_driven: The number shown is what the model expected of her rather than a read of what she actually did on the floor that season.
definition.no_player_links: Player pages cover the current season only, so names in a past season are not links.

sources.impact_rating: our on-court impact rating chain, as it stood at that season's end
sources.minutes_actual: official box scores from that season
